components.name: Solid Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #16150f; color: #f7f4ec; border: 1.5px solid #16150f; font: 650 1rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16150f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Redwood pill, only for booking on WhatsApp.
components.html: Book on WhatsApp
components.css: .ds-btn-book { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #8b2e22; color: #f7f4ec; border: 1.5px solid #8b2e22; font: 650 1rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-book:hover { background: #a8402c; border-color: #a8402c; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-book:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16150f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #16150f; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; font: 650 1rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-dish { display: block; width: 240px; padding: 16px; background: #1d3a2b; color: #f7f4ec; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dish-img { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 6px; background: #141a16; } .ds-dish h3 { font: 400 1.3rem/1.15 Gloock, Georgia, serif; margin: 14px 0 6px; } .ds-dish-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-dish-meta b { font: 700 1.2rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f2cf83; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mark { width: 15px; height: 15px; border: 1.5px solid #5cc46a; border-radius: 2px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; } .ds-mark::after { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5cc46a; } .ds-dish-line { font: 400 0.9375rem/1.5 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #c9d8cd; margin: 0; } .ds-dish:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f7f4ec; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid rgb(22 21 15 / 0.14); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(22 21 15 / 0.14); color: #16150f; } .ds-faq summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 64px; padding: 14px 0; font: 400 1.3rem/1.25 Gloock, Georgia, serif; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary::after { content: ''; width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; background: linear-gradient(#8b2e22, #8b2e22) center / 16px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#8b2e22, #8b2e22) center / 2px 16px no-repeat; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-faq[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-faq p { margin: 0 0 20px; color: #57564d; font: 400 1.0625rem/1.6 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The site opens the way the venue does after dark: solid night, the green neon name, the real fairy-light tunnel. Then it settles into a calm ivory page, and the evening returns in bands of deep lawn green and night. Each section picks one of three tones and sets every colour inside it from that tone, so a component works anywhere without its own dark-mode logic.

Density is editorial and phone first. Big Gloock headlines and short Hanken Grotesk paragraphs, thin 1 px rules instead of boxes, real photos in lightly rounded frames, and pill buttons. Every section on a page uses a different composition. The venue photos are the proof, so they are only shown at sizes where they hold up, and text never sits on top of them.
keyCharacteristics: Three section tones (paper, night, green) that set colour through local custom properties.
Gloock serif at 400 for every headline; Hanken Grotesk 400 to 700 for UI; Yellowtail only for the neon name.
Thin rules (1 px at 14 to 20% of the text colour) divide lists, FAQs and fact tables.
Pill buttons, 6 px photo frames, 10 px cards.
WhatsApp, Call, Directions and Menu are always one tap away on phones.

rules.name: The Gold After Dark Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only on night or green. On paper, the same accent role is redwood.

rules.name: The Redwood Means Book Rule
rules.body: A filled redwood button always starts a booking (WhatsApp). Other actions use the tone's solid or ghost button.

rules.name: The One Tone Rule
rules.body: Every section carries exactly one of `.tone-paper`, `.tone-night` or `.tone-green`, which sets `--bg`, `--fg`, `--mute`, `--line`, `--accent`, `--price`, `--btn-bg` and `--btn-fg`. Components read those variables and never hard-code a tone.

rules.name: The Plain Headline Rule
rules.body: Headlines are sentence case, Gloock 400, with no italic, no highlighted or recoloured word, and no eyebrow or numbered label above. `h1 em` renders upright in the inherited colour. A sequence number may sit inline in a step heading (the party steps).

rules.name: The One Sign Rule
rules.body: Yellowtail with the neon glow appears once, as the name in the Home hero. It is decorative (`aria-hidden`), and the h1 carries the name for screen readers.

rules.name: The Reach Rule
rules.body: Phones keep a 64px night action bar fixed at the bottom (Menu, Call, Directions, WhatsApp), and the body pads for it plus the safe area. Desktop drops the bar and puts "Book on WhatsApp" in the header.

rules.name: The 44 Rule
rules.body: Every link, chip, button and list row is at least 44px tall. Buttons are 50px, sheet links 58px, list rows 52px.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Cards, frames and sections have no shadow. If something casts a shadow, it floats over the page.

dos: **Do** give every section exactly one tone class and let components read `--fg`, `--mute`, `--line`, `--accent` and `--price`.
**Do** put booking on a redwood pill and send it to WhatsApp; keep WhatsApp, Call and Directions within one tap on phones.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px or more and body text at 17px or more on phones.
**Do** show only real venue photos, in 6px frames, at sizes where they hold up, and label food photos as illustrative.
**Do** write headlines in sentence case in Gloock 400, and show prices in bold tabular Hanken.
**Do** give each section on a page its own composition, using the 5/7, 7/5, 4/8 and 4/7 splits and offsets.
**Do** write in English only, and write the name exactly as "Red Wood Farm".
donts: **Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker or numbered label above a headline. A sequence number may sit inline in a step heading.
**Don't** italicise, highlight or recolour a word inside a headline.
**Don't** place text on a photo, or repeat a dark text-over-photo hero down the page.
**Don't** pin sections or scroll-scrub motion on phones, and don't cross-fade one image over another.
**Don't** use Yellowtail or the neon glow anywhere except the one neon name.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, frames or sections.
